experience: Concurrent implementers were told to use separate workspaces, adding setup, adoption and merges instead of sharing the lead's workspace.

source.decision: Owner decision, 16 Nov 2026: one workspace per Spec, with bounded isolation exceptions.

setup.context: Repository acme/app, assigned workspace /home/user/app. Shared types and interfaces are settled and committed. You own src/report.ts; the helper owns src/csv.ts and its focused tests. Neither piece needs a server or database.

prompt: Start one implementer on CSV escaping and its focused tests while you keep writing the report module. The shared interface is escapeCell(value: string): string; quote values containing commas and double embedded quotes. Start the helper now, then leave its implementation to it. Do not start a new conversation.
notes: Measures the workspace choice, not helper execution or integration. The unchanged default or explicit lead assignment is accepted; isolation and shell workspace allocation are forbidden.

experience: An attempt the lead may discard must remain separate rather than changing the lead's working implementation.

source.decision: Owner decision, 16 Nov 2026: discardable attempts remain isolated.

setup.context: Repository acme/app, assigned workspace /home/user/app. A workspace for the disposable attempt is already allocated at /home/user/app-attempt on the committed base. You keep writing src/report.ts in /home/user/app.

prompt: Start an implementer to try a streaming CSV encoder. This is an experiment we may throw away, not part of the report implementation yet. Give it the already allocated attempt workspace; keep our current encoder unchanged. Start it now; you will compare its returned revision later.
notes: Control for over-correcting to shared workspaces even for a discardable attempt; allocation is already complete.

pattern: child instructions force concurrent writer isolation
experience: A delegated writer's shorter instruction block independently asserted that concurrent writers must be isolated.

source.decision: Owner decision, 16 Nov 2026: delegated writers share the delegating writer's workspace too.

setup.context: Repository acme/app, assigned workspace /home/user/app. You own src/report.ts. Shared interfaces are settled; a helper can own src/csv.ts and its tests without changing your module. No server or database is needed.

prompt: You may delegate one bounded supporting piece: start an implementer on CSV escaping and its tests while you continue the report module. The settled interface is escapeCell(value: string): string, quoting comma-containing values and doubling embedded quotes. Start that helper now; retain the report implementation yourself.
notes: Replays the managed child's product instructions, not a native harness subagent; checks only the next writer's workspace choice.
